author: laura.desmet@foo.be
title: Work Regulations Amendment No. 3 - Article 7.3 (signed 1 March 2023)
body:
Amendment No. 3 to the Work Regulations of Foo BV. In force from 1 March 2023. This amendment replaces Article 7.3.

New Article 7.3 - A medical certificate is not required for an incapacity for work that lasts only one day, up to 3 times per calendar year. The employee must still inform their direct manager before 10:00 and register the absence in the employee portal on the same day.
For the fourth one-day absence in a calendar year, and for every absence longer than one day, the employee must submit a medical certificate within 48 hours from the start of the absence.

Foo BV does not make use of the exception for employers with fewer than 50 employees.

Drafted by: Marc Dubois, SD Worx (payroll consultant for Foo BV). Questions about this article: contact Marc Dubois.
Signed: Laura De Smet (Head of Operations) and the employee representatives.
